heroRole: Mobile/Backend Developer with a strong focus on Software Quality (QA)
bio: Software Engineer with hands-on experience in mobile ecosystems (Android, Kotlin, Jetpack Compose) and backend (Node.js, C#, PHP). I focus on building readable and maintainable applications by applying Clean Architecture, actively participating in the design of RESTful APIs and the integration of relational databases (MySQL, SQL Server). Through my experience in institutional environments, I integrate Quality Assurance (QA) into the development cycle, executing test plans and automation (JUnit, MockK) to validate deliverables. My goal is to contribute reliable code and continue consolidating my technical skills.
